Name: Rita's Winery Hill
Author: RitaEmiko
Description:
This is my second map. I personally love to have waterfalls in my farm so here it comes.
这是我的第二个地图。我个人很喜欢有瀑布的农场。

This map is designed for my need of growing all veggie and fruit for my winery. There's a large diggable area dedicated to Winery & other Artisan good mods users.
这个地图的设计初衷是有好看而足够的区域种植各种农作物用以酿酒。适合喜欢酿酒以及各种其他手工制品mod的玩家。

Farm cave is hidden behind the waterfall as usual (this time is easier to find, right next to Grandpa's shrine).
农场洞穴老样子在瀑布后面（爷爷的墓碑边上）。

Again, I don't know how to fix the weird looking tile in front of the greenhouse but it doesn't not affect game play.
我仍然不知道如何解决温室前地块色差的问题，不过不影响游戏。
